notes.title: Update 2025.20.09 – Balancing, Fixes & New Features
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone, with the latest Update 2025.20.09 we’re bringing a lot of improvements, bug fixes, and balancing changes to the game. Thanks to everyone who provided feedback and reported bugs – many of these changes come directly from your input.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Corrected database entries[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted tax calculation in Burkina Faso[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue with city cost rating[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed an issue when too many transports existed at once[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed a bug that prevented penalty payments[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2] Gameplay Changes[/h2][list][*][p]Production and employee growth is no longer linear[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced income from high-end contracts[/p][/*][*][p]Added more profitable contracts at game start[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted costs across the board[/p][/*][*][p]Added difficulty control[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]Visual Improvements[/h2][list][*][p]City tokens now display correctly after loading[/p][/*][*][p]Replaced the forest area around Bern[/p][/*][*][p]South Sudan’s flag now displays correctly[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted valuation numbers to more understandable values[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]Balancing[/h2][list][*][p]Rebalanced location and transport costs[/p][/*][*][p]Increased penalty payments[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]That’s it for this update! We’re already working on the next patch and look forward to your continued feedback in the forums or on Discord.[/p]

notes.title: Version 2024.20.04
notes.content:
Today is a smaller update that mainly focuses on bug fixes with a few new features.

[b]Function[/b]
[list]
[*] the 'Next turn' button is now locked during the turn
[*] MainHUD now shows the stock level per city in addition to the global stock level
[*] The camera can now be set back to the original rotation (key: “R”)
[/list]

[b]Balancing[/b]
[list]
[*] the starting region no longer has a disadvantage after January 31st of the first year
[/list]

[b]Other[/b]
[list]
[*] Minor change to the loading screen
[*] Several improvements to the save system
[*] Improved centering of a selected city via CityUI
[/list]

[b]Bug fix[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the GameState was not set correctly
[*] a bug regarding transports has been fixed
[*] fixed a bug where the MainHUD displayed incorrect information before the game started
[*] a bug regarding the autofocus of the camera has been fixed
[*] a bug that could lead to a memeory leak has been fixed
[*] fixed a bug that caused goods to be counted multiple times during delivery
[list]

notes.title: Version 2024.19.04
notes.content:
After a long wait, we finally have a new update for you. And this time it's a big one. Over the past few weeks, we have completely overhauled some old subsystems - both visibly and under the hood.
The most impressive of these is our new map. Completely redesigned with new assets and new materials to achieve a more cohesive look. It now also supports Nanite, which has noticeably improved performance.

Regarding performance; we have also updated Nvidia DLSS to version 3.7.0. This brings improved image quality with more stable details and less ghosting.

Since we were mainly busy updating old systems and UI, we only have two new features for you today: The camera can be rotated and customer stock levels are displayed to get a better feel for “When will new orders arrive?”.

tldr;
[b]Feature[/b]
[list]
[*] Added possibility to rotate the camera
[/list]

[b]Visual[/b]
[list]
[*] Map completely reworked to improve both graphics and performance
[*] small assets reworked
[/list]

[b]Other[/b]
[list]
[*] Nvidia DLSS updated to 3.7.0
[*] Significantly improved settings UI
[*] Updated menu navigation with a more modern look and feel
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the number of employees could become negative
[*] Fixed an issue where the user interface was not updated when hiring +/- employees
[*] Fixed an issue where the quarterly report and win/loss window were not displayed
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - 2024.08.01
notes.content:
Bug Fixes:
- Fixed English localization for improved clarity and consistency.
- Addressed a crash occurring when a City lacks a Warehouse and Rentstorage reaches full capacity, 
   preventing disruptions to gameplay.
- Corrected the display of Airports in the City Selection Window, providing accurate information to 
  players.
- Various event-related fixes for enhanced stability and functionality.

Gameplay Adjustment:
- Increased the impact of player sales on the growth of customer base, providing a more dynamic and 
  rewarding economic experience.
